source_note: Marathon (module 4 v2). base/invoicekit (invoicekit, plain Node, `npm test`), 25 dependent requests in 5 groups of 5 sent one per call in order (fixtures/marathon/requests.json); house rules stated once in request 1, six decisions stated once in later requests; hidden tests after every call (each request plus every earlier one, under two time zones). Unit: a request; kept = passed right after its call and still passing at the end. One long session on both sides (it auto-compacts on its own). With: CLAUDE.md: 'While you work, keep NOTES.md in the repo root up to date: goal, constraints, what you found, what failed, next step. Re-read it before each major step.' Without: no CLAUDE.md.
